SELECT d.diet_type_value
FROM Diets AS d
JOIN Nutritionists_Diets AS nd
  ON d.diet_type_id = nd.diet_type_id
GROUP BY d.diet_type_id, d.diet_type_value
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT nd.nutritionist_id) = (
  SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM Nutritionists
)

SELECT cs.description
FROM customer_support AS cs
JOIN streaming_service_customer_support AS sscs
  ON cs.id = sscs.customer_support_id
GROUP BY cs.id, cs.description
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sscs.streaming_service_id) = (
  SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM streaming_service
)

SELECT sm.type
FROM Social_Media AS sm
JOIN Streaming_Service_Social_Media AS sssm
  ON sm.social_media_id = sssm.social_media_id
GROUP BY sm.type
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sssm.streaming_service_id) = (
  SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM Streaming_Service
)

SELECT mm.model_name
FROM Monetization_Model AS mm
JOIN Streaming_Service_Monetization_Model AS ssmm
  ON mm.id = ssmm.monetization_model_id
GROUP BY mm.id, mm.model_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ssmm.streaming_service_id) = (
  SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM Streaming_Service
)

SELECT cs.language
FROM Captions_and_subtitles AS cs
JOIN Streamings_captions_and_subtitles AS scs
  ON cs.caption_id = scs.captions_and_subtitles_id
GROUP BY cs.language
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT scs.streamings_id) = (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT streaming_id)
  FROM Streamings
)

SELECT c.cuisine_name
FROM Cuisines AS c
JOIN Food_Critics_Cuisines AS fcc
  ON c.id = fcc.cuisine_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.cuisine_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fcc.food_critic_id) = (
  SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM Food_Critics
)

SELECT c.description
FROM Components AS c
JOIN Ux_Designers_Components AS udc
  ON c.id = udc.component_id
GROUP BY c.description
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT udc.ux_designer_id) = (
  SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM Ux_Designers
)

SELECT e.end_date
FROM Elections AS e
JOIN Political_Reporters_Elections AS pre
  ON e.id = pre.election_id
GROUP BY e.end_date
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pre.reporter_id) = (
  SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM Political_Reporters
)

SELECT c.description
FROM Courses AS c
JOIN Online_Learning_Platforms_Courses AS olpc
  ON c.courseID = olpc.courseID
GROUP BY c.description
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT olpc.platformID) = (
  SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM Online_Learning_Platforms
)

SELECT b.benefitName
FROM Benefits AS b
JOIN Credit_Card_Benefits AS ccb
  ON b.id = ccb.benefitId
GROUP BY b.id, b.benefitName
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ccb.creditCardId) = (
  SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM Credit_Cards
)

SELECT f.description
FROM Facilities AS f
JOIN Terminals_Facilities AS tf
  ON f.id = tf.facilityId
GROUP BY f.description
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tf.terminalId) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Terminals)

SELECT e.Description
FROM Exhibitions AS e
JOIN Art_Galleries_Exhibitions AS age
  ON e.ExhibitionID = age.ExhibitionID
GROUP BY e.ExhibitionID, e.Description
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT age.GalleryID) = (
  SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM Art_Galleries
)

SELECT s.ServiceName
FROM Services AS s
JOIN Hotels_Services AS hs ON hs.Service_ID = s.ServiceID
GROUP BY s.ServiceID, s.ServiceName
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT hs.Hotels_ID) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Hotels)

SELECT a.amenityName
FROM Amenities AS a
JOIN Hotel_Amenities AS ha
  ON a.amenityId = ha.amenityId
GROUP BY a.amenityId, a.amenityName
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ha.hotelId) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Hotels)

SELECT f.value
FROM Functions AS f
JOIN Health_Apps_Functions AS haf
  ON f.functionID = haf.functionID
GROUP BY f.functionID, f.value
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT haf.healthAppID) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Health_Apps)

SELECT e.name
FROM Equipment AS e
JOIN Movie_sets_equipment AS mse
  ON e.id = mse.equipment_id
GROUP BY e.id, e.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT mse.movie_set_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Movie_sets)

SELECT Degree_Level.level_name, COUNT(Job_Post.id)
FROM Degree_Level
LEFT JOIN Job_Post ON Degree_Level.id = Job_Post.degree_level_id
GROUP BY Degree_Level.id, Degree_Level.level_name

SELECT Movie.title, Movie.genre, Movie.release_year, Director.name
FROM Movie
JOIN Director ON Movie.director_id = Director.id

SELECT name, mean_commute_time
FROM Neighborhood
WHERE population < 10000

SELECT r.name, d.group_name
FROM Readers AS r
JOIN Demographic_Groups AS d
  ON r.demographic_group_id = d.id

SELECT Name, Official_Language
FROM Countries
ORDER BY Population ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT Name, Founding_Year
FROM Financial_Institutions
ORDER BY Total_Liabilities DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT c.PhoneNumber, c.AddressLine
FROM Customers AS c
JOIN Tickets AS t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
JOIN Concerts AS co ON t.ConcertID = co.ConcertID
JOIN Artists AS a ON co.HeadlineArtistID = a.ArtistID
WHERE a.Genre = 'Pop'

SELECT Costume_Designer, Costumes
FROM Costumes
WHERE Budget < 750000

SELECT DISTINCT Topic.name
FROM Enrollment
JOIN Project ON Enrollment.projectId = Project.id
JOIN Topic ON Project.topicId = Topic.id
WHERE Enrollment.grade > 90

SELECT *
FROM Articles
WHERE visualStorytelling IN ('Photo', 'Video')
  AND articleType = 'Technology'

SELECT name
FROM Psychologists
WHERE clinic = 'Harmony Wellness Center'
UNION
SELECT name
FROM Psychiatrists
WHERE clinic = 'Harmony Wellness Center'

SELECT FullName
FROM Customers
WHERE Sign_in_Options = 'biometric authentication'
  AND (Digital_Solutions = 'mobile banking' OR Digital_Solutions = 'internet banking')

SELECT PassingMark
FROM Assessments
WHERE Assessor = 'Professor Smith'
  AND AssessmentMethod IN ('Exam', 'Quiz')

SELECT Books.Title
FROM Books
JOIN Publishers ON Books.PublisherID = Publishers.PublisherID
WHERE Books.Educational_Materials = 'Textbook'
  AND Publishers.Email = 'pearson@email.com'

SELECT buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes
ORDER BY buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
LIMIT 4

SELECT SUM(t2.overall_rating) / COUNT(t2.id)
FROM Player AS t1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2
  ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', t2.date) >= '2010'
  AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) <= '2015'
  AND t1.height > 170

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
  ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.weight = (
  SELECT MAX(weight)
  FROM Player
)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
       NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT Patient.ID,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age,
       Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE CAST(Laboratory.RBC AS REAL) < 3.5

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l."ID")
FROM "Laboratory" AS l
JOIN "Examination" AS e ON l."ID" = e."ID"
WHERE l."CPK" < 250
  AND (e."KCT" = '+' OR e."RVVT" = '+' OR e."LAC" = '+')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id)
FROM member
JOIN attendance ON member.member_id = attendance.link_to_member
JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE event.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
  AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'

SELECT 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN event.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN budget.amount END) /
       SUM(CASE WHEN event.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN budget.amount END)
FROM budget
JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE budget.category = 'Advertisement'
  AND event.event_name IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting')

SELECT MAX(spent)
FROM budget
WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL

SELECT expense.cost
FROM expense
JOIN budget ON expense.link_to_budget = budget.budget_id
JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE expense.expense_description = 'Post Cards, Posters'
  AND event.event_name = 'September Speaker'

SELECT b.category
FROM budget AS b
JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.location = 'MU 215'
  AND e.type = 'Guest Speaker'
  AND b.spent = '0.0'

SELECT DISTINCT g.Country
FROM gasstations AS g
JOIN transactions_1k AS t
  ON g.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date LIKE '2012-08-%'

SELECT DISTINCT t.Time
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g
  ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE g.ChainID = 11

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers)
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN customers AS c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND t.Date = '2012-08-25'

SELECT s.CharterNum, s.AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sch
  ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sch.CharterNum IS NOT NULL

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account AS a
JOIN disp AS d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district AS di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC, di.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(l.amount)
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT c.client_id,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
       - (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) AS age
FROM client AS c
JOIN disp AS d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card AS ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
WHERE ca.type = 'gold'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT AVG(oxygen_count)
FROM (
  SELECT m.molecule_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'o' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS oxygen_count
  FROM molecule AS m
  LEFT JOIN atom AS a
    ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE m.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
  )
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
)

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(bond_type = '=') / COUNT(bond_id), 5) AS percentage
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR008'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(molecule.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cards.uuid)
FROM cards
JOIN legalities ON cards.uuid = legalities.uuid
JOIN rulings ON cards.uuid = rulings.uuid
WHERE legalities.format = 'premodern'
  AND rulings.text = 'This is a triggered mana ability.'
  AND cards.side IS NULL

SELECT DISTINCT s.name
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE c.name = 'Angel of Mercy'
  AND s.mtgoCode IS NOT NULL
  AND s.mtgoCode != ''

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
FROM cards
WHERE setCode IN (
  SELECT code
  FROM sets
  WHERE name = 'Coldsnap'
)

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
  SELECT UserId
  FROM badges
  GROUP BY UserId
  HAVING COUNT(Name) > 5
)

SELECT
  (
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2010' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*)
  ) -
  (
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2011' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*)
  ) AS percentage_difference
FROM badges
WHERE Name = 'Student'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT schools.CDSCode)
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND schools.Charter = 0
  AND frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
  AND frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" < 0.18

SELECT posts.Id
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'slashnick'
ORDER BY posts.AnswerCount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT superhero.superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY superhero.height_cm DESC

WITH eye_color_counts AS (
  SELECT
    c.colour AS eye_color,
    COUNT(s.id) AS superhero_count
  FROM superhero AS s
  JOIN publisher AS p
    ON s.publisher_id = p.id
  JOIN colour AS c
    ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
  WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
    AND s.id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.colour
)
SELECT
  eye_color,
  superhero_count,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY superhero_count DESC) AS rank
FROM eye_color_counts
ORDER BY superhero_count DESC, eye_color

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM publisher AS p
JOIN superhero AS s ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
    SELECT MIN(ha2.attribute_value)
    FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
    JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
    WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  )

SELECT superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE gender.gender = 'Male'
  AND weight_kg > (
    SELECT AVG(weight_kg) * 0.79
    FROM superhero
  )

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
    SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
    FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
    JOIN attribute AS a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id
    WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'strength'
  )

SELECT GSoffered
FROM schools
ORDER BY ABS(Longitude) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad'

SELECT s.City, COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
  ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.GSoffered = 'K-8'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY s.City

SELECT r.name
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND res.rank = (
    SELECT MIN(CAST(res2.rank AS INTEGER))
    FROM results AS res2
    JOIN drivers AS d2 ON res2.driverId = d2.driverId
    WHERE d2.forename = 'Lewis'
      AND d2.surname = 'Hamilton'
  )

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) - MIN(A11) FROM district) AS salary_gap
FROM client AS c
JOIN disp AS d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account AS a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT code
FROM drivers
WHERE nationality = 'American'

SELECT r.year, r.name, r.date, r.time
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races AS r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.dob = (SELECT MAX(dob) FROM drivers)
  AND r.date = (
    SELECT MIN(r2.date)
    FROM qualifying AS q2
    JOIN races AS r2 ON q2.raceId = r2.raceId
    WHERE q2.driverId = d.driverId
  )

SELECT ProjectName
FROM Development_Projects
WHERE Increased_Capacity = '1000 Passengers per Day'
  AND (ProjectName LIKE '%expansion%' OR ProjectName LIKE '%renovation%')

SELECT Description
FROM Photos
WHERE SubjectID IN (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Subjects
  WHERE Name = 'History'
)
UNION ALL
SELECT Description
FROM Illustrations
WHERE SubjectID IN (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Subjects
  WHERE Name = 'History'
)

SELECT fs.species_name
FROM Fish_Species AS fs
JOIN Aquaculture_Facility_Fish_Species AS affs
  ON fs.id = affs.fish_species_id
GROUP BY fs.id, fs.species_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT affs.aquaculture_facility_id) = (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id)
  FROM Aquaculture_Facility
)

SELECT r.restrictionType
FROM Restrictions AS r
JOIN Routes_Restrictions AS rr
  ON r.restrictionType = rr.restrictionsType
GROUP BY r.restrictionType
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rr.routesId) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Routes)

SELECT s.price
FROM Services AS s
JOIN Real_Estate_Agencies_Services AS reas
  ON s.service_id = reas.service_id
GROUP BY s.price
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT reas.real_estate_agency_id) = (
  SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM Real_Estate_Agencies
)

SELECT i.description
FROM Community_Development_Corporations AS cdc
JOIN Community_Development_Corporations_Initiatives AS cdci
  ON cdc.id = cdci.community_development_corporation_id
JOIN Initiatives AS i
  ON cdci.initiative_id = i.id

SELECT f.fleetName, f.capacity
FROM Fleets AS f
JOIN Airlines_Fleets AS af
  ON f.id = af.fleetId
GROUP BY f.id, f.fleetName, f.capacity
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT af.airlineId) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Airlines)

SELECT ap.degree_program_id,
       ap.degree_summary_name
FROM Academic_Programs AS ap
JOIN Student_Enrolment AS se
  ON ap.degree_program_id = se.degree_program_id
GROUP BY ap.degree_program_id,
         ap.degree_summary_name
ORDER BY COUNT(se.student_id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT PetType, AVG(weight)
FROM Animals
GROUP BY PetType

SELECT t.Template_Type_Code
FROM Documents AS d
JOIN Templates AS t ON d.Template_ID = t.Template_ID
GROUP BY t.Template_Type_Code
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.CountryCode)
FROM state AS s
JOIN countrylanguage AS e ON s.Code = e.CountryCode
JOIN countrylanguage AS d ON s.Code = d.CountryCode
WHERE e.Language = 'English'
  AND d.Language = 'Dutch'

SELECT p.Code, p.Name
FROM Products AS p
JOIN products_price AS pp
  ON p.Code = pp.code
 AND p.Price = pp.min_price

SELECT investor_id, SUM(share_count) * 1.0 / COUNT(transaction_id) AS average_share_count
FROM Transactions
GROUP BY investor_id

SELECT avg_gradepoint
FROM enrolled_in_gradeconversion_student_gradepoint
WHERE lname = 'Smith'

SELECT sum_hoursperweek, sum_gamesplayed
FROM sportsinfo_student_hoursperweek_gamesplayed
WHERE lname = 'Shieber'
  AND fname = 'David'

SELECT AVG(Money_Requested) AS avg_money_requested
FROM entrepreneur

SELECT max_points
FROM climber_points
WHERE country = 'United Kingdom'

SELECT avg_no_of_customers
FROM bank_no_of_customers

SELECT AVG(body_builder.Total)
FROM body_builder
JOIN people ON body_builder.People_ID = people.People_ID
WHERE people.Height > 200

SELECT AVG(d.access_count) AS avg_access_count
FROM Documents AS d
JOIN Document_Functional_Areas AS dfa
  ON d.document_code = dfa.document_code
JOIN Functional_Areas AS fa
  ON dfa.functional_area_code = fa.functional_area_code
WHERE fa.functional_area_description = 'Acknowledgement'

SELECT sum_amount_settled
FROM settlements_amount_settled

SELECT SUM(Order_Items.Order_Quantity)
FROM Order_Items
JOIN Products ON Order_Items.Product_ID = Products.Product_ID
WHERE Products.Product_Name = 'photo'

SELECT max_followers, sum_followers
FROM user_profiles_followers

SELECT h.given_name
FROM Highschooler AS h
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Friend AS f
  WHERE f.student_id = h.ID
)

SELECT employee_id, max_end_date
FROM job_history_end_date

SELECT SUM(Order_Items.Order_Quantity)
FROM Order_Items
JOIN Products ON Order_Items.Product_ID = Products.Product_ID
WHERE Products.Product_Name = 'photo'

SELECT name, sex
FROM people_candidate_oppose_rate

SELECT avg_attendance
FROM performance_attendance

SELECT SUM(maxOccupancy)
FROM Rooms
WHERE decor = 'modern'

SELECT product_type_code, AVG(product_price) AS average_price
FROM Products
GROUP BY product_type_code
